feeds.title: Eat Live Travel Write
feeds.description: Eat Live Travel Write by Mardi Michels is a blog about culinary adventures, near and far. Recipes (with a focus on French food), travel stories, kids' cooking, cookbook reviews and more. She is a full-time French teacher at an elementary school for boys in Toronto and runs cooking classes for boys aged 7-12.

feeds.title: Immigration Canada
feeds.description: Immigration Canada is a resource for people interested in working, visiting, studying, and immigrating to Canada. Hi I'm Andy Rodriguez and along with this blog, I run an Immigration Consultancy Firm in order to provide my services to people interested in studying, working, investing, and living in Canada.

feeds.title: Off Track Travel
feeds.description: Explore beyond the beaten path by foot, road and paddle with Jean Robert and Gemma at Off Track Travel. We are a British-Canadian couple who love to travel and discover lesser-known places. We want to share these experiences to inspire and help others to do the same.

feeds.title: Hayley on Holiday
feeds.description: Check out blog posts on worldwide solo travel guides, travel essentials, destinations, and Canada working holiday inspiration. Hayley on Holiday was founded by Hayley Simpson, a freelance travel content writer and solo travel blogger based in Australia. She has traveled across North America and Europe multiple times.

feeds.title: Correr Es Mi Destino » Canadian Life
feeds.description: Juliette Giannesini shares interesting snippets and accounts from her Canadian LIfe in this section of Correr Es Mi Destino. Juliette is a French Canadian writer, and translator and shares her cultural adventures in Canada and around the world when she goes backpack traveling.

feeds.title: Brits In Toronto
feeds.description: Brits in Toronto is a handy resource for the best pubs, curry, jobs and dental care in the city. All the good and the bad will be here, with a bit of personal opinion thrown in. I'm John, aka British Bloke, and I started this blog as a resource for British immigrants to find interesting things to do in Toronto.

feeds.title: Expat In Canada
feeds.description: Expat In Canada by Tim and Camila provides useful knowledge to make life in Canada easier, cheaper and more convenient. They are travelers based in Canada and have created this blog to share the best tips, resources available for living a life in Canada.

feeds.title: Cape Town to Calgary
feeds.description: Cape Town to Calgary blog follows our adventures, camping trips, and family fun stories across Canada. We're a South African family that recently moved to Canada. We love sharing some of our experiences and adventures along the way as we build our new lives in Calgary.

feeds.title: The Loud Americans
feeds.description: The Loud Americans is about a family of 5 who have been living as ex-pats in India and now Canada. Originally started as a random thought blog it now covers their life journey, vacations, travels, and important events.

feeds.title: Montreal Travel Blog
feeds.description: Find the best things to do, where to eat and where to stay during your stay in Montreal. Make the most of your holidays with our Montreal Travel blog. I'm Melissa Giroux, Montreal resident and blooger. I believe Montreal and its surroundings are worth visiting and hope I'll be able to help you fall in love with this beautiful city.

feeds.title: 1st Move International Blog » Moving to Canada
feeds.description: 1st Move International gives you everything you need to know about moving from the UK to Canada. Find the latest news and advice from international removals experts. We are a specialist overseas moving company offering bespoke packing and fast weekly shipping services for personal effects and household goods

feeds.title: My Expat Life - That's Hamori
feeds.description: My Expat Life - That's Hamori is a journal, where I, Eva Hamori, blog about our story and experiences with French culture, our life in metropolitan Budapest, and our traditional southern French life in the village of Capestang. It is about how our young family adapts to change and adventure, while we visit different parts of Europe.
